pre_registration.motivation_disclosed: This family was declared after a STRONG BUY on SBIN lost money and the skipped month was the suspected cause. That makes it a post-outcome hypothesis search, which is why the whole family is declared, corrected for, and closed — and why a winner is evidence to investigate rather than a model to ship.

conclusion: No variant meets the pre-declared rule. V1.4 stands unchanged.

adjustment.convention: adjusted(t) = close(t) * PROD(multiplier for ex_date > t); the most recent close is unadjusted and history is scaled to meet it
adjustment.look_ahead: none in any return: the factor cancels except for actions inside the window, all of which had occurred by the end of it. Levels do carry future actions, and no frozen factor reads a level.

limits: One market period, monthly rebalances. Closes are corrected for splits, bonuses and dividends; traded value is left as printed. Horizons beyond three months were left out when this study was registered, because the archive then held too few non-overlapping windows for them. Nothing here establishes a durable edge for any variant, including the baseline.
